observations: Window: 120 closed H4 bars from 1788494400000 (open 2504.38) to 1790222399999 (close 2675.48); net +172.01 points. Window low 2358.62 and window high 2850.00 are both printed in the second half of the window.

Early decline: bar 1788523200000 opened 2523.22 and closed 2450.96 after a 2436.73 low. The next ~38 bars overlap between 2411.04 (low of 1789041600000) and 2528.8 (high of 1788739200000), alternating direction with frequent upper and lower tails.
Failed first spike: bar 1789128000000 opened 2457.12, ran to 2680 and closed 2555.52; the two following bars topped at 2607.62 and 2545.29, and the gain was fully given back.
Bear acceleration into the window low: bar 1789473600000 (2475.02 open, 2390.73 low, 2423.29 close) and bar 1789488000000 (2423.22 open, 2358.62 low, 2412.95 close) both closed near their lows.
Buy-climax tail: bar 1789977600000 opened 2658.81, printed 2850 and closed 2723.15, leaving a 126.85 upper tail; the highest close after it is 2775.61 (1790020800000).

Post-high overlap: bars 1790035200000 through 1790136000000 hold a 2716.01-2786.81 band with small, heavily overlapping bodies; bar 1790164800000 then broke down (2726.71 open, 2648.49 low, 2659 close).

Pullback low 2641.37 (1790179200000) sits just below the 2641.7 low of the 2700 breakout bar 1789948800000 and below the 2658.06 low of the 2850 bar, so the entire 2700/2850 up-breakout has been retraced.

structures.description: Early/mid-window two-sided balance: heavy bar overlap between the 2411.04 low (bar 1789041600000) and the 2528.8 high (bar 1788739200000), with alternating bodies, frequent tails and no sustained close outside either edge before the 2680 spike.

Failed bull breakout out of that balance: bar 1789128000000 ran 2457.12 -> 2680 and closed 2555.52, a wide range with an upper tail; follow-through topped at 2607.62 and 2545.29, and price later printed a lower low at 2358.62.
Bear leg from the 2609.02 high (bar 1789416000000) to the window low 2358.62 (bar 1789488000000): about 250 points in six bars, including two wide bear bars closing near their lows.

Bull leg from the 2358.62 low to the 2850 high (bar 1789977600000): higher highs 2438.47, 2519.81, 2643.52, 2700 (twice) and higher lows 2370.54, 2435.71, 2568.16; several wide bull bars close near their highs. The 2700 double top (1789804800000 and 1789948800000) was exceeded by the 2850 print.

Pullback after the 2850 high: fourteen bars of lower highs (2804.59, 2786.81, 2748.23, 2695.84) and mostly overlapping small bodies, then a break to 2641.37 (bar 1790179200000) that reversed within two bars; price remains below the 2700 level and inside the 2568.16-2850 leg.

evidence_for: Higher-high/higher-low progression is intact on this window: lows 2370.54 -> 2435.71 -> 2568.16 -> 2641.37 and highs 2438.47 -> 2519.81 -> 2643.52 -> 2700 -> 2850 (bar 1789977600000 is only 16 bars before the decision time).

The widest, strongest bodies of the window are bull bars closing near their highs (1789732800000 close 2578.6 vs high 2585.5; 1789747200000 close 2636.28 vs high 2643.52; 1789992000000 close 2754.31), unlike the earlier failed 2680 spike.

The pullback low 2641.37 holds above the last higher low 2568.16 (1789891200000) and above the 50% level of the 2358.62-2850 leg (2604.31), which is the classic shallow-pullback position inside a bull leg.

The 2641.37 low also matches the origin of the 2700 breakout bar (1789948800000 open 2642.9, low 2641.7), and the last two bars (2676.47, 2684.16 closes) show buyers stepping in at that breakout base.
No bar since the 2850 high has closed below the 2609.02 swing high of the preceding bear leg, so the higher-timeframe up structure has not been negated.
evidence_against: The 2850 breakout was not accepted: bar 1789977600000 closed 126.85 below its high, the best close afterwards is 2775.61 (1790020800000), and the pullback low 2641.37 is below the 2658.06 low of that bar and below the 2641.7 low of the 2700 breakout bar, i.e. price is back inside the pre-breakout range top.
The pullback broke the 2716.01 (1790049600000) and 2717.02 (1790150400000) swing lows, so the immediate sequence is lower lows as well as lower highs, not a one-bar flag.
Fourteen bars of small, heavily overlapping bodies between 2641.37 and 2786.81 with failed breaks in both directions is two-sided, range-type behavior rather than trending follow-through.

The earlier part of the same 120-bar window contains a comparable opposite leg (2609.02 -> 2358.62, about -250) plus a failed 2680 spike (1789128000000), so the window as a whole is not one-directional.
transition_conditions: Bull resumption: consecutive closes back above 2700 and then above the pullback range high 2786.81 (1790136000000), with wide bull bodies closing near highs, would restore a bull-trend/channel read instead of a pullback range.
Bull invalidation: a close below 2641.37 followed by a close below 2568.16 (1789891200000) would break the higher-low sequence and shift the read toward trading-range with bear pressure.
Range confirmation: continued overlap between 2641.37 and 2786.81 without a decisive close outside either edge keeps the current pullback/range phase in force.
Climax test: if price keeps making lower highs below 2775.61 with closes near lows and never revisits 2850, the 1789977600000 bar reads as a completed buy climax rather than a fresh breakout leg.

Two-sided resolution: a close above 2748.23 (1790150400000 high) together with a higher low above 2641.37 would show the pullback has turned up; a close under 2666.2 (1790208000000 low) with a lower high would show the pullback extending.
